pcs.pc_description: receive and inspect raw whole spices for damage, mold, pest infestation, and moisture levels as per organizational standards
identify and segregate spices based on type and intended processing requirements
remove foreign matter using tools like aspirators, air classifiers, sieves, magnets, and SORTEX machines for high-precision optical sorting
operate destoners, magnetic separators, and SORTEX machines to eliminate stones, metallic contaminants, and discolored or damaged pieces
grade spices by size, shape, density, and color using manual or mechanical sorters, and automated grading through SORTEX machines where applicable

• perform spice-specific cleaning and sorting procedures, such as: • • Chilies – remove stalks, dust, and use SORTEX for rejecting moldy/discolored pods • • Turmeric – wash, scrub, drain, and use SORTEX for post-drying color grading • • Cumin/Coriander/Fennel – remove pod fragments, chaff, and stones; use SORTEX for purity improvement • • Cardamom/Cloves/Pepper – sort by color and size; remove discolored/damaged pieces using SORTEX
dry cleaned spices using sun drying, tray drying, or forced-air drying methods based on spice type and pass dried spices through SORTEX for final cleaning and grading
transfer dried whole spices to the cutting machine safely, ensuring zero spillage and minimal wastage
set cutting machine controls to obtain the desired spice size and texture for further processing
sterilize whole spices using an automated sterilizer, setting controls (temperature, time, pressure, and water level) as per standard procedures
monitor the sterilization process and establish critical control points (CCP) to ensure food safety and prevent contamination
inspect produced samples for parameters such as color, size, moisture content, and cleanliness
handover produced samples to the quality lab for testing and verification in accordance with organizational practice
set and monitor the roasting machine controls (such as temperature and time) to ensure adequate roasting
operate spice millers to pulverize roasted spices,, placing the spices safely and adjusting grinder screens as per standard practice
collect milled spices in clean, food-grade containers or bags and allow them to cool adequately.
adjust and operate sifting/sieving equipment to remove contaminants and ensure powder uniformity
operate blending machines to produce spice blends or curry powder (e.g., chili powder, turmeric powder, garam masala, etc.) as per formulation and production requirements
operate sterilization equipment (pressure, temperature, sterilization time) using industry- recommended chemicals to remove microbial contaminants
set and monitor vacuum drying chamber controls (temperature, pressure, time) for proper drying of sterilized spices
collect and cool single spice powders (e.g., chili powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder) before packaging, ensuring minimal product loss and maintaining quality.
collect and cool blended spice mixes (e.g., garam masala, sambar powder) before packaging, ensuring uniformity of mix and preserving product quality.
submit samples of spice powders and blended spice mixes to the quality control department for inspection, testing, and verification as per standard procedures.
add ingredients in the correct sequence and proportion to prepare mixtures for blending, based on the type of seasoning to be produced.
sieve the mixture to obtain the required fineness of seasoning.
monitor the blending and sieving process to ensure food safety and prevent contamination.
collect and cool the seasoning adequately before packaging.
collect product samples and perform initial checks before submitting them for quality verification as per standard protocols
document significant process parameters, defects observed, and corrective actions taken.
load appropriate packaging materials into the machine as per product type (e.g., pouches, bottles, jars, sachets)
load different types of spices onto the packaging machine (whole spices, powdered spices, curry powders, and seasonings)
set controls of the packaging machine, monitor the in-feed, and ensure compliance with packaging standards
check for the presence of metallic substances in packaged products using an automated metal detector

record all necessary packaging details as per FSSAI regulations (e.g., product name, weight, manufacturer details, batch number, best-before date, ingredient list, nutritional value, allergen warnings, etc.)
ensure verification of packaging data by both production and QC departments
report discrepancies in product packaging or labeling to the supervisor
maintain production records in manual or digital formats (ERP systems) as per industry standards
track finished products back to their raw ingredients for quality audits and traceability
transfer final products to the quality lab for shelf-life analysis and verification
clean work areas, machinery, and tools using recommended cleaning agents and sanitizers after completing production tasks
inspect tools, equipment, and machinery to identify defects, ensuring proper upkeep and maintenance
follow allergen handling procedures to prevent cross-contamination, documenting necessary precautions and cleaning measures
report equipment faults to the concerned department/supervisor as per organizational protocols
